matchTalkingPoints: Notable by their absence are both Adam Page (was #3) and Kris Statlander (was #1). As neither have had a match in the past 6 weeks (Statlander has but not counting ones of 5 minutes or longer), they have dropped out of their respective divisions. That puts Thekla atop the Women's rankings for the very first time! So she is both the Women's champion and top rated women's wrestler now. Also, Mark Briscoe has been out of action and after slipping down to #12 last week has now also become inactive. Despite her poorly rated match against Kamille (3.83), Willow Nightingale gains two places to #3, which is due to both Toni Storm and Statlander dropping out. Kamille meanwhile re-enters at the bottom of the Women's. The best matches of the week were (again) The Young Bucks vs The Rascalz (7.89) on Collision and Will Ospreay vs Hechicero (7.83) on Dynamite. The latter moved up 9 places to #24. Will he crack the top 10 with more regular performances?
othersToNote: No changes in the top rankings for Men's or Women's Tag. Cassidy, O'Reilly & Strong have now entered the Trios division at the bottom; it will take more than their Collision match (rated 6.79) to progress up the Trios rankings. 10 dropped out of the Men's rankings this week, which is why there have been a lot of gains, especially at the lower end of the rankings.
